title: 12.9 Million Teenagers Just Took the Hardest Exam on Earth
description:
China's 2026 gaokao just wrapped — and 12.9 million students registered for the single most high-stakes exam on the planet. Two days, one score, and it largely decides which university you get into. The twist: this year's number is actually DOWN from 13.35 million last year, as China's graduate job market shifts.

Which country's exam system would you survive? Subscribe for more on how the world tests its students.
